posts.text:
We were taken off X today.

We won't spend a word on why. We know exactly what happened, and it stays with us.

What we will say is this: it clarified things.

This project was never built for the timeline. More than seventy charts, every number rebuilt from the chain, every method published. That was never going to be for everyone, and it doesn't need to be.

It's for the few who want to see through. People who'd rather check a number than repeat one. Who read the chart before they read the take.

So that's who we build for now. A small circle, on our own ground. No algorithm deciding who sees what.

No noise. Just data.

If that's you, you're already here.
